think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and documented valid range/default. 2) Check whether any particular numeric value (e.g., 0, -1) is documented to switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/sentinel) rather than just being a smaller/larger amount. 3) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
